newsitem.title: USA: PR Newswire acquires Southwest Newswire.
newsitem.headline: PR Newswire acquires Southwest Newswire.

text.p: PR Newswire, a unit of United News & Media Plc, said on Monday it acquired Southwest Press Relations Wire from Westward Communications Inc for undisclosed terms.
Dallas-based Southwest Newswire, a regional distributor of corporate and other news releases, serves Texas and adjoining states, the companies said.
Westward Communications is a newspaper publisher with properties in Texas, Colorado, Arkansas and Louisiana.
"Our two organizations have collaborated closely for more than 20 years," PR Newswire president Ian Capps said.

"This merger of Southwest's strong local client base and media presence with PR Newswire's advanced global service offerings will provide excellent benefits for public relations and investor relations professionals in the region."
